d: A leading regional retailer is seeking a Head of IT to lead the technology strategy, aligning IT infrastructure, applications, digital platforms and data analytics with business goals. Ensure strong governance, cybersecurity and system performance while driving digital transformation and vendor management.
TLDR; Retail background mini-CIO needed to overhaul IT org
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field; Master's degree is an advantage.
Minimum 12 years of IT experience in FMCG retail or a related technology field, including at least 8 years in a leadership role.
Professional certification such as PMP, ITIL, or equivalent.
Hands-on experience with SAP ERP and POS systems. Experience with ERP transformation and migration.
Fluency in Arabic and English (verbal and written) is mandatory.
r: Define and execute the technology strategy and roadmap, aligning IT initiatives with business objectives and emerging digital trends.
Establish IT governance, risk management and business continuity frameworks, and oversee cybersecurity, infrastructure and operations using best practices such as ITIL.
Lead enterprise applications (SAP ERP, POS), business intelligence and data analytics, and drive enterprise-wide digital transformation.
Manage IT budgets, procurement, vendor relationships and contract negotiations to secure value and cost effectiveness.
Oversee project governance and lead, develop and appraise the technology team, reporting regularly to the CEO on results.

d: CELINE, founded in 1945 by Céline Vipiana, is an iconic French Leather-Goods, Fashion & Couture House belonging to the LVMH Group. To have a chance of joining CELINE, you must thrive as a team player in a fast-paced environment amongst passionate, agile, and authentic people.

As a Operations Associate, you will report to the Store Manager, playing a crucial role in maintaining the store’s operational excellence. You will oversee inventory management and stock accuracy, ensuring seamless coordination of deliveries and stock processes. Embedded in CELINE’s environment, your role will support the Maison’s commitment to exceptional service and operational precision, contributing to a harmonious and efficient store operation.
r: Leverage a keen commercial mindset to optimize stock levels, supporting the store’s objectives and enhancing the overall efficiency of inventory management. Your role will directly contribute to achieving the store’s sales goals through effective stock control.

Cultivate an in-depth knowledge of CELINE’s products to ensure accurate stock handling and seamless integration of new arrivals. Your expertise will support the store’s luxury positioning by maintaining impeccable product quality and presentation.

Foster a collaborative and positive atmosphere within the team. Your role will involve actively supporting and engaging with colleagues, ensuring that team dynamics align with CELINE’s values of excellence and sophistication.

Enhance the client experience through meticulous stock management. Ensure that all inventory processes support the delivery of exceptional service, reflecting CELINE’s commitment to creating memorable and personalized client interactions.

Oversee all facets of stock management, including inventory accuracy, stock movements, and delivery processes. Ensure that stock levels are meticulously maintained to support the store’s operational needs and reflect CELINE’s high standards of precision and luxury.

Manage administrative tasks and stock-related processes with an emphasis on accuracy and efficiency. Work closely with your manager to implement and refine procedures, ensuring compliance with internal guidelines and enhancing overall operational effectiveness.

Adhere to CELINE’s policies and regulatory requirements in all aspects of stock management. Collaborate with your manager to ensure that all stock activities are compliant, supporting a well-organized and legally sound back-of-house environment.

Uphold CELINE’s prestigious image through impeccable stock management and presentation. Your attention to detail will ensure that all aspects of inventory handling contribute to the store’s luxurious ambiance and brand integrity.
Represent CELINE with authenticity and pride, embodying the Maison’s values in every aspect of your role.

Experience: +2 years of experience in stock management within luxury/fashion business Competencies: Exceptional ability to manage inventory and administrative tasks with precision and efficiency, ensuring seamless stock operations and adherence to internal processes. Meticulous attention to detail in stock management and compliance, demonstrating a strong commitment to accuracy and quality in all aspects of the role. Dedicated approach to supporting the store’s operational needs and enhancing the client experience, reflecting CELINE’s values of excellence and sophistication. Effective teamwork and communication skills, working closely with managers and colleagues to achieve operational goals and maintain a harmonious work environment. Languages English, proficiency of other language(s) will be an advantage.
